capex.source: KO 10-K purchases of property, plant and equipment: FY2024 and FY2025 10-Ks

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth 1.9% reported (organic higher, FX/refranchising drag); mid-single-digit organic pricing/mix growth fading toward long-term nominal growth. Analyst judgement, not company guidance.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 reported margin 28.7% (13,762/47,941) incl. 1,261 other operating charges; FY2023 24.7%, FY2024 21.2% (large charges). 30% assumes charges normalise, approx. comparable margin level.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: KO effective tax rate typically ~18-21%; 20% used. Not taken from a specific filing figure.

wacc.source: Assumption: low-beta (~0.6) staple, rf ~4.2%, ERP ~5%, modest leverage and cost of debt ~4.5-5% pre-tax gives ~6.5-7.5%; 7.0% used.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: roughly long-run inflation/nominal GDP, below risk-free rate

net_debt.source: KO FY2025 balance sheet (Q4 release 2/10/26 / ARS): loans and notes payable 1,551 + current maturities of LTD 1,822 + LTD 42,119 = 45,492, less cash 10,270 and short-term investments 3,602 (13,872). Marketable securities (1,934) excluded per convention.

diluted_shares.source: KO Q4/FY2025 earnings release 2/10/26: average shares outstanding assuming dilution, full year 2025 = 4,313 million
